// Postgres access for the operations designed on this service. Generated by Tessery.
// Rows come back as JSON built by Postgres, and every value goes in as text with a cast to the column's type, so
// Postgres does all type conversion.

using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Npgsql;
using NpgsqlTypes;

/// <summary>A status code and a JSON body ready to send; a null body means no content.</summary>
public record DbResult(int Status, string? Body)
{
    public IResult Send() => Body is null ? Results.StatusCode(Status) : Results.Text(Body, "application/json", statusCode: Status);
}

public static class Db
{
    const long MigrationLock = 727274;
    static NpgsqlDataSource? pool;
    internal static NpgsqlDataSource Pool => pool ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Db.Open was not called");

    /// <summary>Connects to the postgres:// address and applies each migration in migrations/__MIGRATIONS_DIR__ that has not run yet, in
    /// order. Replicas wait on a lock.</summary>
    public static async Task Open(string address, ILogger log)
    {
        var u = new Uri(address);
        var cs = new NpgsqlConnectionStringBuilder
        {
            Host = u.Host,
            Port = u.Port > 0 ? u.Port : 5432,
            Database = Uri.UnescapeDataString(u.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/')),
            MaxPoolSize = 10,
        };
        if (u.UserInfo.Length > 0)
        {
            var parts = u.UserInfo.Split(':', 2);
            cs.Username = Uri.UnescapeDataString(parts[0]);
            if (parts.Length > 1) cs.Password = Uri.UnescapeDataString(parts[1]);
        }
        foreach (var pair in u.Query.TrimStart('?').Split('&', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
        {
            var kv = pair.Split('=', 2);
            if (kv[0] == "sslmode" && kv.Length > 1 && Enum.TryParse<SslMode>(kv[1].Replace("-", ""), true, out var mode)) cs.SslMode = mode;
        }
        pool = NpgsqlDataSource.Create(cs);
        for (var attempt = 1; ; attempt++)
        {
            try
            {
                await Migrate(log);
                return;
            }
            catch (MigrationFailed) { throw; }
            catch (Exception e) when (e is NpgsqlException or TimeoutException && attempt < 30)
            {
                log.LogInformation("database not ready ({Error}), retrying in 2s", e.Message);
                await Task.Delay(2000);
            }
        }
    }

    sealed class MigrationFailed(string file, Exception e) : Exception($"migration {file} failed: {e.Message}", e);

    static async Task Migrate(ILogger log)
    {
        var dir = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "migrations", "__MIGRATIONS_DIR__");
        if (!Directory.Exists(dir)) return;
        await using var conn = await Pool.OpenConnectionAsync();
        await Exec(conn, null, $"SELECT pg_advisory_lock({MigrationLock})");
        try
        {
            await Exec(conn, null, "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _tessery_migrations (name text PRIMARY KEY, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())");
            foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(dir, "*.sql").Order(StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                var name = Path.GetFileName(file);
                await using (var seen = new NpgsqlCommand("SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _tessery_migrations WHERE name = $1)", conn))
                {
                    seen.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter { Value = name });
                    if ((bool)(await seen.ExecuteScalarAsync())!) continue;
                }
                await using var tx = await conn.BeginTransactionAsync();
                try
                {
                    await Exec(conn, tx, await File.ReadAllTextAsync(file));
                    await using var mark = new NpgsqlCommand("INSERT INTO _tessery_migrations (name) VALUES ($1)", conn, tx);
                    mark.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter { Value = name });
                    await mark.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                    await tx.CommitAsync();
                }
                catch (PostgresException e)
                {
                    await tx.RollbackAsync();
                    throw new MigrationFailed(name, e);
                }
                log.LogInformation("applied migration {Name}", name);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            await Exec(conn, null, $"SELECT pg_advisory_unlock({MigrationLock})");
        }
    }

    static async Task Exec(NpgsqlConnection conn, NpgsqlTransaction? tx, string sql)
    {
        await using var cmd = new NpgsqlCommand(sql, conn, tx);
        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
    }

    internal static DbResult Error(int status, Dictionary<string, string> fields) => new(status, JsonSerializer.Serialize(fields));

    internal static readonly DbResult NotFound = Error(404, new() { ["error"] = "not_found" });

    internal static DbResult Rejected(PostgresException e, ILogger? log = null)
    {
        var code = e.SqlState ?? "";
        if (code == "23502" && e.ColumnName is { } col) return Error(400, new() { ["error"] = "invalid", ["field"] = col, ["detail"] = col + " is required" });
        if (code == "23505") return Error(409, new() { ["error"] = "already_exists", ["detail"] = e.Detail ?? "" });
        if (code == "23503") return Error(409, new() { ["error"] = "reference_not_found", ["detail"] = e.Detail ?? "" });
        if (code.StartsWith("22") || code.StartsWith("23") || code == "42703") return Error(400, new() { ["error"] = "invalid", ["detail"] = e.MessageText });
        log?.LogWarning("database error: {Error}", e.Message);
        return Error(500, new() { ["error"] = "internal" });
    }

    internal static string Quote(string name) => "\"" + name.Replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"";

    internal static string Snake(string k) => Regex.Replace(k, "([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", "$1_$2").ToLowerInvariant();

    /// <summary>Reads a JSON object body as column text values; anything else counts as empty.</summary>
    internal static Dictionary<string, string?> ReadBody(string? body)
    {
        var row = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(body)) return row;
        try
        {
            using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
            if (doc.RootElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) return row;
            foreach (var p in doc.RootElement.EnumerateObject())
            {
                row[p.Name] = p.Value.ValueKind switch
                {
                    JsonValueKind.Null or JsonValueKind.Undefined => null,
                    JsonValueKind.String => p.Value.GetString(),
                    JsonValueKind.True => "true",
                    JsonValueKind.False => "false",
                    _ => p.Value.GetRawText(),
                };
            }
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            // not JSON: treated as empty
        }
        return row;
    }

    /// <summary>Query keys a list understands besides column names.</summary>
    internal static readonly HashSet<string> Reserved = ["limit", "offset", "page", "q", "sort"];

    internal static bool TextType(string t) => t is "text" or "citext" || t.StartsWith("varchar") || t.StartsWith("character");

    internal static string Like(string s) => "%" + s.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("%", "\\%").Replace("_", "\\_") + "%";
}

public sealed class Table(string name, string key, string order, Dictionary<string, string> types, string[] writable)
{
    string Cast(string col, int n) => $"${n}::text::{types.GetValueOrDefault(col, "text")}";

    string Where(Dictionary<string, string?> filter, List<string?> args)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        foreach (var (k, v) in filter)
        {
            args.Add(v);
            parts.Add($"{Db.Quote(k)} = {Cast(k, args.Count)}");
        }
        return string.Join(" AND ", parts);
    }

    static async Task<DbResult> One(int status, string sql, List<string?> args)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var cmd = Db.Pool.CreateCommand(sql);
            foreach (var a in args) cmd.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter { NpgsqlDbType = NpgsqlDbType.Text, Value = (object?)a ?? DBNull.Value });
            var raw = await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
            return raw is string json ? new DbResult(status, json) : Db.NotFound;
        }
        catch (PostgresException e)
        {
            return Db.Rejected(e);
        }
    }

    Dictionary<string, string?> Pick(string? body)
    {
        var row = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        foreach (var (k, v) in Db.ReadBody(body))
        {
            var c = Db.Snake(k);
            if (writable.Contains(c) && c != key) row[c] = v;
        }
        return row;
    }

    Dictionary<string, string?> WithKey(Dictionary<string, string?> filter, string id)
    {
        var all = new Dictionary<string, string?> { [key] = id };
        foreach (var (k, v) in filter) all[k] = v;
        return all;
    }

    static int Number(string? v, int fallback) => int.TryParse(v?.Trim(), out var n) ? n : fallback;

    /// <summary>?q= searches text columns, ?column= filters, ?sort=column or -column orders, ?page= or ?offset= with ?limit= pages.</summary>
    public Task<DbResult> List(IQueryCollection query, Dictionary<string, string?> filter)
    {
        string? Q(string k) => query.TryGetValue(k, out var v) ? v.ToString() : null;
        var limit = Math.Clamp(Number(Q("limit"), 50), 1, 500);
        var offset = Q("offset") is { } o ? Math.Max(Number(o, 0), 0) : (Math.Max(Number(Q("page"), 1), 1) - 1) * limit;
        var match = new Dictionary<string, string?>();
        foreach (var (k, v) in query)
            if (types.ContainsKey(k) && !Db.Reserved.Contains(k) && v.ToString().Length > 0) match[k] = v.ToString();
        foreach (var (k, v) in filter) match[k] = v;
        var args = new List<string?>();
        var where = Where(match, args);
        var search = (Q("q") ?? "").Trim();
        var cols = types.Where((e) => Db.TextType(e.Value)).Select((e) => e.Key).Order(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
        if (search.Length > 0 && cols.Count > 0)
        {
            var clause = "(" + string.Join(" OR ", cols.Select((c) => { args.Add(Db.Like(search)); return $"{Db.Quote(c)} ILIKE ${args.Count}"; })) + ")";
            where = where.Length == 0 ? clause : where + " AND " + clause;
        }
        var sortBy = order;
        var sort = Q("sort") ?? "";
        var col = sort.TrimStart('-');
        if (types.ContainsKey(col)) sortBy = $"{Db.Quote(col)} {(sort.StartsWith('-') ? "DESC" : "ASC")}, {order}";
        return One(200, $"SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r), '[]'::json)::text FROM (SELECT * FROM {Db.Quote(name)}{(where.Length == 0 ? "" : " WHERE " + where)} ORDER BY {sortBy} LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset}) r", args);
    }

    public Task<DbResult> Get(string id, Dictionary<string, string?> filter)
    {
        var args = new List<string?>();
        var where = Where(WithKey(filter, id), args);
        return One(200, $"SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM {Db.Quote(name)} r WHERE {where}", args);
    }

    public Task<DbResult> Create(string? body, Dictionary<string, string?> fixedValues)
    {
        var row = Pick(body);
        foreach (var (k, v) in fixedValues) row[k] = v;
        if (row.Count == 0) return One(201, $"WITH r AS (INSERT INTO {Db.Quote(name)} DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", []);
        var cols = row.Keys.ToList();
        var args = cols.Select((c) => row[c]).ToList();
        return One(201, $"WITH r AS (INSERT INTO {Db.Quote(name)} ({string.Join(", ", cols.Select(Db.Quote))}) VALUES ({string.Join(", ", cols.Select((c, i) => Cast(c, i + 1)))}) RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", args);
    }

    public Task<DbResult> Update(string id, string? body, Dictionary<string, string?> filter)
    {
        var row = Pick(body);
        // The parent and owner the route scopes to cannot be moved by the caller.
        foreach (var k in filter.Keys) row.Remove(k);
        if (row.Count == 0) return Task.FromResult(Db.Error(400, new() { ["error"] = "invalid", ["detail"] = "nothing to update; writable fields are " + string.Join(", ", writable) }));
        var cols = row.Keys.ToList();
        var args = cols.Select((c) => row[c]).ToList();
        var sets = string.Join(", ", cols.Select((c, i) => $"{Db.Quote(c)} = {Cast(c, i + 1)}"));
        var where = Where(WithKey(filter, id), args);
        return One(200, $"WITH r AS (UPDATE {Db.Quote(name)} SET {sets} WHERE {where} RETURNING *) SELECT row_to_json(r)::text FROM r", args);
    }

    public async Task<DbResult> Remove(string id, Dictionary<string, string?> filter)
    {
        var args = new List<string?>();
        var where = Where(WithKey(filter, id), args);
        try
        {
            await using var cmd = Db.Pool.CreateCommand($"DELETE FROM {Db.Quote(name)} WHERE {where}");
            foreach (var a in args) cmd.Parameters.Add(new NpgsqlParameter { NpgsqlDbType = NpgsqlDbType.Text, Value = (object?)a ?? DBNull.Value });
            return await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync() == 0 ? Db.NotFound : new DbResult(204, null);
        }
        catch (PostgresException e)
        {
            return Db.Rejected(e);
        }
    }
}
